description: Internal performance change. After load_all/1, populate an ETS :bag table keyed by event type instead of scanning Extension.t() list on every dispatch. Zero changes to extension authors or their tests.

comments.text: Audit (2026-04-26): the ETS dispatch table was implemented but never wired into mix pi's runtime — Interactive uses Loader-loaded plain Extension structs and Dispatcher.emit, never emit_from_table. Reverted in spirit by opi-fin.19; the consolidated framework uses plain maps inside the Runner, not ETS.

title: Phase 3: ETS dispatch table
